messages.subject: Campus Drive: Solent Analytics - Data Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Solent Analytics is hiring Data Engineers (CTC 12 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT, ECE | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/solentDE by 11:59 PM, 25 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: Re: Campus Drive: Solent Analytics - Data Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Correction: ECE students are no longer eligible for the Solent Analytics Data Engineer drive. Eligible branches are now CSE and IT only. All other details unchanged.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: Re: Campus Drive: Solent Analytics - Data Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Update: the registration deadline for the Solent Analytics Data Engineer drive has been extended to 11:59 PM, 30 September 2026. All other eligibility details remain unchanged.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: Re: Campus Drive: Solent Analytics - Data Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Further update: the backlog rule for the Solent Analytics Data Engineer drive has been relaxed. Students with up to 1 active backlog are now eligible. All other details remain as extended previously.

Regards,
Career Office
